title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode1 Christmas Plans

meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Another day of high-intensity lessons.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm so grateful that I get to learn so much about theatre from the fundamentals.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Whether that's techniques unique to acting while singing or playing female characters...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Doing things that I normally don't get to will not only help me communicate better with actors, but also broaden my perspective as a director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to think Emu is also learning quite a lot about the operational side of—)
Oh! Ruiiiiii!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had a feeling it was you! Did you have a wonderhoy day?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Emu.
Are you also on your way home?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I learned a lot again today☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Where's Tsukasa? Is he not with you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He said he's going to practice on his own for a bit in order to master what we covered in class today as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?! Nene's doing the same thing!
She just sent me a message saying that she's also gonna practice on her own!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means I need to keep learning as much as I can too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'm sure you will.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Emu, what have you been learning about recently?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, so they showed me around the theatre and...
Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! You guys got to practice that today?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Ballet's intriguing since the elegant movements can surely be applied to quite a number of situations.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa even said that he'd like to try using some during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our next show...? Oh, the one we're gonna do at the ski resort?! I really love the story you came up with for that, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait since it's been so long since the last time we did a show together♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it has.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to thank your brothers once again for giving us this wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A show on the slope of a ski resort...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, it's a subsidiary of the Otori Group, and they're apparently going to put on a Christmas show for children.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: A few cast members from Phoenix Wonderland are scheduled to perform...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But the resort specifically asked for you to direct the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm honored, but... Why me?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Apparently, the owner of the resort has seen your troupe perform.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And he particularly enjoyed the stage effects.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That explains the situation.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Of course, you don't have to accept since we know you're all busy right now with your Morinomiya lessons.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I appreciate the concern...
But I'd like to accept this offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I haven't been getting many chances to direct lately. And more importantly, it's not every day that you get to put on a show at a ski resort.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to this opportunity since I gained many new perspectives in terms of directing the last time I did this.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll let them know that you're accepting their offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Oh, while we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would it be possible for me and the others to accept this offer as Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: As Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since the others also stand to benefit from the experience of performing at such a unique place.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Understood. Then, I'll see what they say about it.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They'll likely need some time to respond, so we'll let you know when we hear back from them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I promise to make the most of this wonderful opportunity I've been given.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that Tsukasa and Nene have also agreed to be in it, I'm looking forward to this show even more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not to mention that it's been quite a while since I last directed a show, so there's a long list of things I've been wanting to try... Hehe. Think about all the possibilities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound all fired up, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: By the way, have you already figured out a plan for this show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm still coming up with ideas...
We'll be doing it on the evening of Christmas Day, so my goal is to make it feel like a dreamlike experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, I'd like to make the climax an unforgettable moment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm currently thinking about using lanterns to create a mystical atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Lanterns...!
I bet it's gonna look sparkly, glowy and really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let me know if you need me to help you with anything! I promise to work super duper hard on stage and behind the scenes when the day comes☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate the offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's all do our best to make our show a wonderful Christmas present for our audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
